completion_rule: Complete all target sets and reps/seconds for every exercise in a single session to unlock the next level.

session_guidelines.cadence: Every other day is ideal (2–4 sessions/week).
session_guidelines.rest_defaults: 60–90s between skill/hold sets; 120–180s for pressing strength sets.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
quick_tips: Lower back glued to the floor.
Exhale gently and keep ribs down.

exercises.name: Push-Ups
quick_tips: Elbows at ~45°, not flared.
Body is one line; no sagging hips.

exercises.name: Hollow Plank
quick_tips: Posterior pelvic tilt; squeeze glutes.
Push the floor away to protract shoulders.

exercises.name: Crow/Frog Stand
quick_tips: Look slightly forward, not straight down.
Knees on triceps; spread fingers for balance.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Ups
quick_tips: Travel forward toward a tripod, not straight down.
Keep elbows tucked; head moves forward between hands.

exercises.name: Wall Walks
quick_tips: Slow and steady; walk hands and feet in sync.
Keep ribcage down and glutes tight.

exercises.name: Chest-to-Wall Handstand Hold
quick_tips: Stack wrists–shoulders–hips; push tall through shoulders.
Squeeze glutes; big toes lightly on wall.

exercises.name: Tuck L-Sit (Parallettes/Floor)
quick_tips: Lock elbows; depress and protract shoulders.
Pull knees toward chest; keep feet off floor.

levels.title: Strength & Control — Bridging to HSPU
levels.rest_guidelines: Take up to 2–3 minutes between pressing sets.

exercises.name: Elevated Pike Push-Ups (Feet 24–30")
quick_tips: Hips stacked over shoulders as much as possible.
Head travels forward to a tripod; elbows tuck.

exercises.name: Wall Handstand Shoulder Taps
quick_tips: Shift weight softly; avoid hopping.
Keep body tight and eyes between hands.

exercises.name: Handstand Shrugs (Wall)
quick_tips: Straight elbows; move only at the shoulders.
Think ‘push the floor away’ to elevate traps.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Rocks
quick_tips: Tiny, smooth rocks without losing lumbar contact.
Exhale on each forward rock to keep ribs down.

exercises.name: Partial-Range Wall HSPU (to AbMat/Pad ~90° elbows)
quick_tips: Lower to a consistent target; neutral neck.
Keep hips off wall; elbows track forward.

exercises.name: Deficit Pike Push-Ups
quick_tips: Hands on plates/blocks to increase ROM.
Control the bottom; drive back to stack.

exercises.name: Handstand Negatives (5s eccentric)
quick_tips: Descend smoothly; tripod head position.
Stay tight; no collapsing on the mat.

exercises.name: Superman/Arch Hold
quick_tips: Squeeze glutes; lift arms and legs evenly.
Keep chin tucked; breathe steadily.

levels.title: Full HSPU — Peak

exercises.name: Strict Wall Handstand Push-Ups (Full ROM to target)
quick_tips: Touch a consistent target with crown of head.
Press back to stack; no kipping.

exercises.name: Deficit Pike Push-Ups
quick_tips: Keep elbows in; drive through full range.
Move forward then back, not straight up and down.

exercises.name: Handstand Hold (Wall or Freestanding)
quick_tips: Active shoulders; fingers ‘grip’ the floor.
Squeeze glutes and quads to stay stacked.

options.name: Hanging Leg Raises
quick_tips: Posterior pelvic tilt; no swinging.
Pull ribs down and control the descent.

options.name: V-Ups
quick_tips: Snap to a V with straight knees.
Lower under control; keep low back down.

levels.final_benchmark_goal: Perform 1 strict handstand push-up (wall or freestanding).
